parsed.post: Discarding the DEPTH=10 attempt (0.9933) as it regressed from my best 0.9803. The model is too deep to converge effectively in 5 minutes at this LR. Reverting to DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=48, MATRIX_LR=0.02. I'll now try to find a better LR/Batch Size balance to maximize training steps.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 and ASPECT_RATIO=48. Testing a lower learning rate (0.01) combined with a smaller batch size (131072) to increase the number of optimizer steps and improve stability within the 5-minute budget.
